_comment: Curated one-line significance per repo, joined onto GitHub activity by the IMMUTABLE numeric repo_id so a rename never drops the framing. repo_name is for humans only. To add a repo: get its id from https://api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<name> (the top-level "id").
